question: What is the strangest thing you have ever inherited?
story: My grandmother left me eleven dollars and a key to a storage unit nobody knew she had. When the will was read, my cousins got cars, jewelry, and actual money. I got eleven dollars and a rusted key. Everyone in that room tried very hard not to laugh at me. The lawyer said Grandma was extremely specific. Exactly that, and nothing else. It took me two weeks to figure out what the key opened. A storage unit forty minutes outside town that she had been quietly paying for since nineteen ninety four. I drove out there expecting junk. Inside were sixty seven boxes, all labeled in her handwriting, all packed with comic books she bought new and never once opened. She was not a collector. She was a grandmother who noticed one grandkid reading them on her floor at age seven. That was me. The eleven dollars was for gas. I sold four boxes and paid off my student loans.
